Episode 147. The King of the Black Sea, Glieak (7)
Three days.
It was absolutely impossible for Siron to arrive here within that time. In fact, even a few months, not ten days, would have been insufficient.
Siron's expedition had already entered the realm of the kings a long time ago, and only they knew the way to that place.
Even if they knew the way, they couldn't reach the realm of the kings in a short period of time, even with Mot's dimensional teleportation ability.
'Kinjelo... What on earth do they want?'
Kinjelo, the only force that knew the identity of the white stone.
Suddenly, such a question popped up in Rosa's mind. What do they want to achieve while driving the world to the brink of destruction?
Of course, it wasn't destruction itself. It was not long ago that Kinjelo shook off the stigma of being a third-rate terrorist group and emerged as the fourth power.
Even after their power was revealed, they are still recruiting members in the same way as before and gaining power.
However, from the bottom rung to the real skillful ones, those who were fascinated by their power and influence were flocking in numbers incomparable to before.
'Their leaders are convinced that the world will not end with this event. There's a high possibility that they didn't think it's because of Siron. They must know that he hasn't left the Black Sea.'
Nothing but the energy of Changseong can kill the King of the Black Sea.
Kinjelo, who knew the identity of the white stone, must have known this fact that everyone gathered here also knew.
'Kinjelo must have some means or something else to stop Glieak.'
Then, what they wanted was clear.
Runcandel and Zipel.
The reduction of power, or the extinction, of the two major families that divide the world.
So, if Kinjelo participates in this battle, the time will definitely be after the two families are on the verge of annihilation.
'I've been thoroughly fooled by those bastards.'
Assuming that all these speculations are correct.
The only way to be less fooled by Kinjelo's plan was to retreat immediately.
Right then, the knights of Runcandel, excluding the Black Knight and the first tier of the Black Sword Association, were seen trying to evacuate after rescuing Jin's comrades.
'But what after the retreat?'
Runcandel and Zipel, Bi-Gung, and Ron.
The moment any one of them leaves, the structure of the battlefield will inevitably collapse quickly.
Keliac will also retreat, and Talalis will have to stay due to Bi-Gung's mission, and Ron due to revenge, but they will definitely be killed.

Even if the strongest warriors and magicians in the world join forces, they cannot deal with the monster. It does not require much imagination to envisage what will happen once it is unleashed into the world.
From that point on, the great powers won't be able to unite again, and Glieak would regain his full original power without any hindrance.
It was impossible to estimate how far the Black Sea transformation would go.

There was no rule that the territories and the empire of the Sword Emperor, and even the lands of Runcandel and Zipel, would not turn into the Black Sea. Because those fighting on the current battlefield had no way to stop the Black Sea transformation.
Therefore, retreating was merely delaying the situation, and the expected cost was never small.
'I didn't expect the fate of the family to be at stake at such an unexpected moment.'
Even if Jin hadn't come to Sword Emperor City, he couldn't have avoided Kinjelo's trap.
The moment Zipel's obsession with the white stone was confirmed, Runcandel would have had no choice but to come here.
In other words, it was an uphill battle from the beginning.
'It's rather fortunate that the youngest is on the battlefield. If that special and enormous power shown at the end of the first battle can be manifested again, it might be a variable.'
The great magic sword, the power of God, manifested through the will of Soldierlet and Clam.

Rosa had clearly seen that power with her own eyes. Although the simple force was definitely inferior to Siron's sword, there was a clear dignity against fate in the magic sword Jin used at the time. For a moment, the level was the same as Changseong.
'But if the youngest could use that power again, he would have brought it out a long time ago.'
It was not a situation where he could save his defeat.
Zuzzuzzuk! Kagang-!
The knights of Runcandel, who rescued the Barmel alliance, were breaking through the chaotic energy that blocked the retreat.
Just as they were about to join them, other children came into Rosa's eyes.
Mu and Ann.
Daughters who are assumed to have met the 'prophet'. Like when Runcandel participated in the last battle, they still maintained a blank expression.
While considering asking them if the prophet had foreseen this situation,
Mu and Ann came to Rosa first and whispered softly.
"Acting head of the family."
"Speak."
"Please restore the second generation. Then, the prophet will lend you power."
Rosa's eyes widened. None of the others heard Mu and Ann's voices.
Pfft.
Soon, Rosa smiled and looked at her daughters.
"That's right, if it doesn't disappoint me, it's not you guys."
Rosa's gaze looking down at Mu and Ann darkened. They bowed their heads, but their faces were not filled with fear or shame like before.
"Get lost. If I return to the family and find even one of my 12th generation comrades dead, you will be executed immediately."
Rosa dismissed Mu and Ann's proposal outright, as if it wasn't worth hearing any more.
In fact, she felt her thoughts were being organized thanks to them speaking the prophet's intentions outright.

'If the prophet is just making up lies to resurrect Joshua, accepting it is meaningless, and if he really has a way to stop the King of the Black Sea, the family won't perish anyway. He exists to fulfill the prophecy.'
Mu and Ann bowed their heads and stepped back.
'The 8th and 9th generations of Runcandel? They dare to speak to Rosa Runcandel in this predicament?'
Watching them, Kelliac pondered.
'The Prophet. It seems that Joshua has fallen and the 8th and 9th generations have become his messengers.'
He, too, was thinking almost identically to Rosa about Kinselo's goal and a way to resolve this situation.
And Kelliac's conclusion was the same as Rosa's. Retreating seemed pointless to him too.

'Although the transcendence of Ron has stabilized the magic stone more than before, it can't harm the King of the Black Sea if it is not completed. Even if Cadun and Hedo join the battle and we sacrifice Veradin, the chances are slim.'
If Jin were to be absorbed by Gliac here, they would never be able to complete the magic stone again.
That's why Kelliac was burning inside more than anyone else on the battlefield.
The battlefield was pure chaos.
Even while thinking, Gliac's attacks were relentlessly pressuring the humans.
The Black Sea's transformation was accelerating, and Gliac showed no signs of retreating even after being struck by Ron's sword hundreds of times.
Jin was covering the rear of the knights trying to escape with the Bamel Alliance alongside Muracan.
Kelliac's gaze landed on him. For a moment, a picture of Zifl reaping the greatest benefit arose in his mind.
'I need to secure Jin Runcandel and escape the battlefield.'
Jin was clearly exhausted. Subduing an exhausted Jin in an instant would not be difficult for Kelliac.
After securing Jin and escaping, if they could complete the magic stone, it would be entirely possible to eliminate the King of the Black Sea later.
Not just that.
Runcandel would suffer near destruction, Ron and the Beogungju would die, and Kinselo's plans would be thwarted.
On the other hand, even if Zifl suffered a massive loss, it would not be a significant problem if they could complete the magic stone.
Perhaps the awakening of Gliac could be the greatest opportunity for Zifl.
However, it was impossible for Kelliac to subdue and secure Jin right away.
Runcandel and Tallaris, and Ron Hiran were keeping a close eye on the situation. If Kelliac tried to capture Jin, they wouldn't stand by idly.
"Cooperate in holding off Gleyack for the time being, and when Ron is defeated and Rosa and Talarris are exhausted, suppress Jin Runecandle. The process will definitely not be smooth."

Although the situation was difficult, Jin would definitely recognize his plan, and he was not the kind of person to just accept it. Not only Rosa and Talarris, but even Ron, who had become a vengeful spirit, could predict this much.
"Does Rosa Runecandle have someone else she trusts? It seems that she rejected the proposal of the 8th and 9th generations. Then now, it's Jin Runecandle's turn to make a proposal to me."
The knights of Runecandle opened the retreat.
"I wish you good fortune!"
"Good fortune!"
In the end, the knights successfully escaped with the Barmel Alliance.
As soon as the knights left, the retreat was blocked again. The chaotic wall trapping the humans was thickening as time went by.
Ron and Talarris fought without thinking about the future for revenge and their mission, and Kellic and Rosa were calculating the survival and interests of their respective families.
Jin's concerns were in between them.
The top priority, his comrades, had escaped the battlefield, so now all that was left was his own survival, the survival of his family, and Ron and Talarris.
Jin was still holding on to Ron, precisely, 'Highran'. Gleyack said he had consumed even Dante's last ceremony, and Ron had unfolded the Sword of the Overlord again.
The moment he gave up on Highran, the meaning of coming to this battlefield would disappear entirely.
That's why he was determined not to give up on Highran until the very end.
"My father cannot come."
Jin saw Rosa gritting her teeth at the moment she heard Talarris's answer.
"And in this situation, if I were Kellic... I would do whatever it takes to secure me and escape. The only best choice Ziple can make is that."
But it was difficult to come up with a way to stop the plan immediately, even if he anticipated it.
The current situation was like everyone holding each other's collars, and the most advantageous among them was Kellic.
That's why Jin had no choice but to take a gamble.
First, he had to make sure Kellic didn't harbor other thoughts.
"Lord Kellic."
Jin approached Kellic and looked him in the eye.

"You must be aware that to deal a fundamental blow to the Black Sea King, the power of Changseong is needed. However, my father cannot come within three days, and you... probably want to seize the opportunity to secure me and leave the battlefield."
"What do you want to say, Jin Runecandle?"
"Three days. During that time when Talarris can seal him, let's negotiate with Kinzello. So, please do your best to help Talarris so that she can unfold the seal."
Kellic narrowed his eyebrows.
As Jin was about to reply, he added this remark.
"If you do not accept my proposal, I will jump right in front of me and die without avoiding Gleyack's sword right now."
